status: proposed; interface approval pending; no benchmark durations or accuracy evidence

hbm_capacity_bytes.basis: Conservative decimal interpretation of Cloud 16 GB; unit conflict with JAX remains. A separate 12e9-byte model allocation budget avoids depending on the upper interpretation.

bf16_mxu_mac_per_s.basis: 197e12 / (2 operations per MAC * 4 MXUs); equal sustained shares at published peak is a model assumption, not four independently measured rates.

int8_mxu_mac_per_s.basis: 393e12 / (2 * 4); estimates the raw INT8 service rate independently of the BF16 format law.

matrix_fill_equivalent_macs.basis: (128+128-2)*128*128 equivalent work from a generic systolic fill/drain model. This is delay-equivalent work, not executed MACs or a derived clock.
matrix_fill_equivalent_macs.material_to: small M and repeated K tiles

vmem_bytes_per_s.basis: Engineering service budget of four 4096-byte register streams per nominal 1 ns vector quantum; aggregate shared local-memory bandwidth, not a physical port count.

hbm_latency_ps.basis: Untuned engineering prior for a DRAM access plus on-chip/controller path, at hundreds-of-ns scale. Public Pallas documentation identifies high HBM latency but gives no v5e value.
hbm_latency_ps.material_to: small streams, gather and insufficient concurrency

hbm_issue_interval_ps.basis: One nominal control-service quantum per logical DMA issue; not a physical core period.
hbm_issue_interval_ps.material_to: short logical spans and credit-bound traffic

hbm_max_outstanding.basis: Logical model window: 32 * 8192 B = 256 KiB, enough to cover nominal bandwidth-delay product (~172 KiB); chosen to permit saturation, not an inferred physical credit count.

vector_tile_ps.basis: One ns for one 8x128 FP32 ordinary vector primitive is an explicit engineering scale prior. JAX supplies layout/relative cost, not this timing; no matrix-peak-to-VPU-rate inference.
vector_tile_ps.material_to: all vector work, especially underfilled decode and reductions

vector_group_startup_ps.basis: Two nominal vector quanta for group setup; charged once to an explicit vector group, not every primitive.

reduction_cost_ratio.basis: Pairwise reduction stage is assigned twice ordinary vector service, reflecting documented slower cross-lane reductions; numerical multiplier is an estimate.

exp_cost_ratio.basis: JAX classifies exp as medium cost versus cheap add/multiply; factor four is an untuned model choice, not a measured instruction ratio.

reciprocal_cost_ratio.basis: Division/reciprocal service is modeled at four ordinary vector quanta; compiler lowering may differ.

rsqrt_cost_ratio.basis: Conservative multi-step reciprocal-square-root estimate; no claim of an eight-instruction v5e implementation.

scalar_op_ps.basis: One ns per scalar/index/control primitive as an engineering prior, unrelated to any asserted TPU clock.
scalar_op_ps.material_to: page indices, issue control, tiny scalar benchmark

kernel_startup_ps.basis: Weak engineering prior of 1 us for device executable entry/prologue/exit; chosen on a microsecond control scale, not from v5e measurements or host launch. The stress range is deliberately two orders wide and is not a physical bound.
kernel_startup_ps.material_to: dominates minimal launch and may dominate small operator units

barrier_latency_ps.basis: One scalar-service quantum for an explicitly mapped barrier; dependency edges alone incur no extra barrier cost.

algorithms.matrix_mapping: one TensorCore; 4 MXUs; M chunks <=1024, N/K chunks <=128; stable output-tile round-robin; K slices kept on the same MXU; distinct useful and padded K/N extents
algorithms.matrix_service: per K slice: (issued_mac_count + matrix_fill_equivalent_macs) / per_MXU_MAC_rate; fill work is never an issued MAC count
algorithms.capacity: 12e9 B HBM budget; 96 MiB shared VMEM; 512 KiB SMEM; per-MXU 512 KiB logical accumulator window backed by and charged to VMEM, not claimed physical accumulator SRAM
algorithms.staging: double-buffer operands and VMEM-backed partials; 64 KiB transient vector scratch budget reserved within VMEM; explicit reads/writes once per transfer, no hidden physical register capacity claim
algorithms.hbm: 8192-byte maximum logical span; split at page and buffer boundaries, no crossing holes; one bandwidth server and shared 32-slot nominal window; latency before bandwidth service, credits held through completion
algorithms.vector: explicit logical 2D shapes; pad rows to 8 and columns to 128; integer tile count, per-operation cost ratios; explicit pairwise reduction stages; one shared vector owner
algorithms.state: fixed invocation; one prime then report; optional two-prime comparison; HBM payload inputs reloaded per invocation; only explicit SMEM coefficient-index/position/page-table metadata persists; full coefficient table stays in HBM
algorithms.kernel_boundary: one device program startup per declared benchmark invocation, also full layer once; no per-op or per-tile duplication; device observability still unknown
algorithms.arbitration: FIFO-ready tie order from existing event scheduler; scalar control issue precedes matrix/vector group dispatch; HBM issue uses its own serialized DMA issue resource
algorithms.counts: canonical semantic operation conventions separated from executed typed/padded primitives and service-only fill work; all casts and scale/mask work retained

unresolved_observation_inputs: Actual XLA fusion/event membership and inclusion of device entry/prologue in the timed envelope; no credible numeric event-correspondence bound before compiler/device observation.
Actual usable memory and cross-invocation retention; model budgets and explicit residency give runnable assumptions, not observed compiler equivalence.
Physical clocks, channels, transaction size, bank/port organization and energy remain unknown and unrepresented; they are not mandatory inputs to this model.
stress_policy: Diagnostic pre-measurement alternatives, not confidence intervals, required campaign rows or probability/physical bounds; no held-out tuning.
